# open-claude-ui attribution

UI behavior, design tokens, and image viewport geometry adapted from
[Caho1/open-claude-ui](https://github.com/Caho1/open-claude-ui), commit
`ddf3aea1711db62fd6d24343bbab500a5ae69f64` (MIT, copyright 2026 Caho1).

Adaptations include Kaus-specific capability/state handling, Chinese input-method
protection, focus ownership, accessibility, reduced-motion behavior, and iframe
sandbox boundaries. The reference repository is an independent reconstruction;
this attribution does not imply an official Anthropic specification or affiliation.

See the accompanying LICENSE for the full upstream license.
